description: Understand a shared checkout before updating or deploying it. Inspect changes and history, then synchronize or publish within configured access. Start with list and status; changes use this server's Git identity and each repository's access limit.
author: Serg Parf

list.help: Find the repository names this instance is configured to use.

autopull.help: Review the last automatic update result. Add now to request one update in the configured mode; running it requires the deploy role.

args.name: now
args.help: true to run one update; text form: autopull <repo> now

status.help: See the current branch, changed paths and untracked files in a repository.

log.help: Review recent commits in a repository.

rev.help: Identify the checked-out commit and branch. A checkout without a branch is reported as detached.

fetch.help: Refresh upstream history and see how many commits are ahead or behind.

diff.help: Review local change sizes and untracked paths before updating or committing.

pull.help: Update a checkout by fast-forward only. A revision selects a detached checkout; a revision and file restore only that file.

args.name: file
args.help: Literal relative file path at that revision

deploy.help: Deploy a repository and review the result record. Fetch first, then use the current or configured branch, or a named branch with an optional reachable revision.

args.name: branch
args.help: Branch; a configured pin cannot be overridden

args.name: rev
args.help: 7..40 lower-case hex, reachable from the origin branch

args.name: id
args.help: Optional correlation id, 1..64 letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen (JSON form)

reset.help: Discard local changes and reset to the configured branch's upstream.

clean.help: Delete untracked files and directories from the checkout.

add.help: Stage selected paths for a commit. Paths are literal and relative to the repository.

args.name: paths
args.help: Paths to stage; JSON array, text has one or more words

commit.help: Save staged changes as a commit using this server's Git identity.

args.name: message
args.help: Commit message; quote it in text calls

push.help: Publish commits using this server's identity and SSH key.

help.help: Find available calls. Use help-config for configuration and help-secret for environment key names.

repos.help: Local name to path, access, optional branch, mode (ff default or mirror) and follow (false default); mirror/follow need deploy or commit access; optional autopull-success-script/autopull-fail-script choose bare names installed by the host admin under the git state directory autopull.d, never paths

ssh_key.help: Absolute private-key file path, never key bytes; absent uses the service account’s keys

autopull-cmd.help: Optional command pubsub channel; required for follow

autopull-log.help: Optional result pubsub channel; absent means no publication
